displayName.zh: 努纳武特浮冰边缘探险

summary.en: Nunavut has the highest density of polar bears. They are apex predators and will hunt humans. Encounters are real and dangerous.
summary.zh: 努纳武特拥有最高密度的北极熊。它们是顶级掠食者，会猎杀人类。遭遇是真实的且危险的。

mitigations.en: Must travel with an armed Inuit guide or licensed outfitter.
mitigations.zh: 必须跟随武装的因纽特向导或持牌户外机构出行。

mitigations.en: Bear bangers and pepper spray are secondary defenses; avoidance is primary.
mitigations.zh: 驱熊弹和胡椒喷雾是次要防御；避让是主要的。

summary.en: Travel is often by 'Qamutik' (wooden sled) pulled by snowmobile over sea ice. Ice cracks and open water leads can appear unexpectedly.
summary.zh: 旅行通常是乘坐雪地摩托拉的 'Qamutik'（木制雪橇）在海冰上进行。冰裂缝和开阔水域可能会意外出现。

mitigations.en: Hold on tight to the sled (suspension is minimal).
mitigations.zh: 紧紧抓住雪橇（减震极少，非常颠簸）。

mitigations.en: Trust the Inuit guide's knowledge of ice conditions implicitly.
mitigations.zh: 绝对信任因纽特向导对冰况的了解。

items.en: Expedition Parka (Canada Goose/Quartz Nature level). It is windy on the open ice.
items.zh: 探险级派克大衣（Canada Goose/Quartz Nature 级别）。开阔冰面上风很大。

items.en: Polarized Sunglasses (Snow blindness is instant on the Floe Edge).
items.zh: 偏光太阳镜（在浮冰边缘雪盲症会瞬间发生）。

items.en: Sunscreen (24-hour sun reflecting off ice burns skin fast).
items.zh: 防晒霜（24小时的阳光在冰面上反射，会快速灼伤皮肤）。

items.en: Alcohol restrictions (Many Nunavut communities are 'dry' or 'restricted'. Do not bring alcohol without checking).
items.zh: 酒精限制（许多努纳武特社区是"禁酒"或"限制"的。未核实前请勿携带酒精）。

message.en: Narwhals are extremely sensitive to sound. When at the Floe Edge waiting for them, you must remain silent. No sudden movements. Drone usage is strictly regulated.
message.zh: 独角鲸对声音极其敏感。在浮冰边缘等待它们时，必须保持安静。不要有突然的动作。无人机的使用受到严格监管。
